Callout.Name: Smuggling - Shore Landing
Callout.Message: Boat landing at a remote beach reported.
Callout.Advisory: One vehicle on the beach, lights off.

Script.Line: The boat is not mine. I am watching it for the owner.
Nobody came off it. Nobody went near it.
The van has nothing to do with the boat.

Lines.Approach: A boat and a van at that beach at this hour, and neither of them is fishing.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
